name: View-Aligned Slicing with 3D Textures
aliases: 3D Texture Volume Slicing with Alpha Blending
definition: A technique using view-aligned slices and 3D textures for volume rendering, leveraging hardware-accelerated tri-linear interpolation to resample the volume at arbitrary locations.
summary: View-aligned slicing with 3D textures is a direct volume rendering method that uses parallel proxy planes perpendicular to the viewer to eliminate sampling artifacts and orientation limitations found in axis-aligned slicing.
